# UC43 — Consumer & Partner Agent — CIMD registration

**Track:** foundations  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T1, T9 · Sections: §4.1, §4.2

## Buyer Story

Customer-facing agents need a discoverable registration path that establishes trust without pretending the identity provider supports CIMD natively.

## PingOne Solution

The BFF runs a clearly labeled CIMD registration facade in the background, stores only public-safe metadata, and keeps the user-owned agent association visible in the NHI inventory.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/agent-builder","label":"Open Consumer & Partner Agent registration"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `CIMD_FACADE_REGISTERED`

## What to Say

> This is the Consumer & Partner Agent registration lane: CIMD is shown as a mock facade because PingOne does not support it natively, while the association and lifecycle evidence are real in the demo.
